description: Main application source code for a Bluetooth Heart Rate Service (HRS) peripheral using Zephyr RTOS. Implements Bluetooth initialization, advertising, connection callbacks, heart rate notifications, battery level simulation, and main loop.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Callback invoked upon Bluetooth connection establishment, logs connection status.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Callback invoked upon Bluetooth disconnection, logs reason.

methods.name: hrs_ntf_changed
methods.description: Callback to handle changes in Heart Rate Service notification status.

methods.name: bt_ready
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth advertising and logs status.

methods.name: auth_cancel
methods.description: Handles pairing cancellation, logs the device address.

methods.name: bas_notify
methods.description: Simulates battery level change and updates battery level characteristic.

methods.name: hrs_notify
methods.description: Simulates heart rate measurement and sends notification if enabled.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main application entry point, initializes Bluetooth, registers callbacks, and runs main loop for notifications.
